_comment: Allowlist of SPDX license identifiers permitted for okf-net dependencies.
Enforced by scripts/check-licenses.py over the CycloneDX SBOM; see the
`licenses` mise task and the `licenses` CI job.
AGENTS.md: dependencies must be Apache-2.0-compatible. Extend this list
deliberately, in its own reviewed commit, with a rationale that cites an
authority — never inline an exception in the checker.
Identifiers are matched case-insensitively (SPDX ids are case-insensitive)
but must otherwise be exact: no `+` (or-later) suffixes, no LicenseRef-*.

allowed.MS-PL: Microsoft Public License. ASF category A -- listed under 'licenses similar in terms to the Apache License 2.0' (https://www.apache.org/legal/resolved.html#category-a), so Apache-2.0-compatible despite its weak per-file reciprocity. Reached us through Xunit.SkippableFact (test-only) and its transitive dependency Validation.
